target_customer: Commercial tenants (retail, industrial, office) seeking space; brokers and landlords respond to posted requirements
problem: Tenants browse static listings and miss off-market space; Commery lets them post requirements and receive inbound matches from brokers and landlords.
business_model: two-sided marketplace (tenant demand-first); monetization not found

founders.name: Andrew Zhou
previous_startups: Labyrinthe (unstaffed coworking space, outcome not found)

founders.name: Lyon Aung
previous_startups: Labyrinthe (unstaffed coworking space, outcome not found)

founders.background_notes: Listed on YC page; no background given

competitors.name: TenantBase
competitors.what: Tech-enabled leasing marketplace matching tenants with tenant-rep brokers
competitors.traction_then: Won a 2021 PropTech Breakthrough marketplace award; ex-Cresa CEO joined as exec chair May 2021

competitors.name: InTheMarket
competitors.what: SaaS for tenant-rep brokers and landlords

competitors.name: VTS Market
competitors.what: Office listings marketplace for remote leasing, landlord side

technical_complexity.rationale: A two-sided listing and matching marketplace for a three-person team; no hard technology is described.

defensibility.rationale: Demand-first listings are copyable by existing CRE platforms; the cold-start supply of brokers was the only asset and no network effect is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Adjacent players were already serving tenants and brokers in 2020-2021; no source shows an incumbent copying or buying Commery.

market_need_then: Not documented beyond the team's own pitch. COVID-era office and retail disruption plausibly raised leasing churn, but no source in this research states demand figures.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, mascot, community or brand coverage found; the site returned HTTP 503 so identity could not be inspected.

outcome_analysis: Commery joined YC in Summer 2021 as a three-person team and is listed Inactive, but no founder post-mortem, press report or shutdown notice was found, so the cause of failure is not public. The marketplace faced established CRE tech players and a cold-start broker supply problem; those are plausible hypotheses only and are not recorded as failure factors without a source.
notes: Cause of shutdown not public; no shutdown date found. CB Insights (aggregator) lists a seed round of about $130K from YC and Zentani; unverified, not recorded as a round. YC page lists Andrew Zhou as CEO while a search summary called Lyon Aung CEO; YC page used. Company site trycommery.com returned HTTP 503 on fetch. Web Archive not used. Completeness pass: the seed of about 130K dated 2021-08-31 is recorded from CB Insights alone; Bouncewatch reports 125K pre-seed on the same date, so the amount conflicts and rests on a single database. Village also lists 125K. No press found.
